symptom: `snippetcall … Params: (Item = $dvOuter)` — a data view's object passed by the data view's name — passed check and exec and described back, and mx check 11.14.0 reported CE0115 "The arguments that are passed to snippet … need to be refreshed" (mendixlabs/mxcli#1746)
cause: buildSnippetCallParams knew three argument kinds (snippet parameter, page variable, everything else as PageParameter); the `widget` kind classifyFlowArgValue already returns for a document widget (#1560) was dropped, so the data view name went into the PageParameter slot
file: mdl/executor/cmd_pages_builder_v3_widgets.go (IsWidget), sdk/pages/pages_widgets_advanced.go, mdl/backend/modelsdk/widget_write.go (Widget slot), mdl/executor/cmd_pages_describe_parse.go (flowArgVariableValue); tests snippetcall_widget_argument_test.go, widget_scoped_variable_test.go
insight: The classifier already said `widget`; the snippet-call consumer mapped only the kinds it knew and let the rest fall into the default slot — when a classifier gains a kind, grep its consumers for a switch without that case. Measure on the reporter's version: 11.12.6 reports nothing for this mapping, base build or fixed, so a measurement there would have proven nothing; 11.14.0 gives the reported 2 x CE0115 on the base build and 0 on the fix.
